title: Free AI-Readiness Check: Score Your Website | Maverank
excerpt: Check how ready your website is for AI search. Get a score out of 100, find things to fix, and share your results. Free, with no signup.
content_html:
Free website check

Is your website ready for AI search?

Get a score out of 100, see what needs work, and share your results. Free, with no signup.

See what needs work

Check your site, make a few fixes, then run it again to see what changed.

Get your score

See how your site scores out of 100, then compare it with sites on the leaderboard.

Find things to fix

See what passed, what needs attention, and what to do next.

Share your results

Send the check link to your team or compare scores with other builders.

What goes into your score?

We check crawler access, page content, and structure. Each finding shows what we checked and what you can improve.

What we score

Access

Can crawlers open your pages?

Rendering

Is your content there before JavaScript runs?

Discoverability

Can crawlers find their way around your site?

Entity & structure

Is it clear who you are and what each page is about?

Citation readiness

Are sources, authors, and dates clear?

Based on what we can check

Your score reflects the checks we can run on your public pages.

If we can’t verify something, we leave it unmeasured instead of marking it as a failure.

How we calculate the score

How does your website score?

Enter your URL to get your score and see what you can improve. No signup needed.
